title: A Corrupted Place
description: Adds a new dimension called Corrupted Place. The mod is still in beta
body:
with 14 cobblestone and Corrupted place portal igniter, you can enter the Corrupted place! you can find beached shipwrecks on the ground, and beware of corrupted villagers! they are really fast, and if you kill them, you will get yourself a corrupted summoner, a tool that summons emerald blocks! and you can find corrupted trees! sometimes they will drop corr fruit, a decent food source! grab some liquid corruption with a bucket, combine it with some glitch blocks and you will get boss summoner! place it on the ground and right click on it, you will summon a mini boss, The Corruption Villager! kill him and get victor glitch! combine it with portal igniter and make victory sword, a sword dealing 200 damage! if you collect some corruption blocks, you can make staff of corruption, a staff that shoots wither skulls!

note: the mod is still in beta. some features may not work. i have never seen naturaly spawning corrupted trees. but do not worry. i will be getting it out of beta someday. and also, credits to MCreator. this was made by a beginner modder
